orchestrator_sessions.summary: The hive is running with elevated CPU/memory pressure and several paused research loops; recent wins include a new model champion and a live Next.js UI on port 3001. Four blockers remain, two of which are high priority and tied to orchestration load and missing retry/backoff logic. We must finish the P1 tasks to restore reliable LLM calls and metrics visibility.
orchestrator_sessions.progress: Added exponential backoff and jitter retries to call_llm() in orchestrator.py for HTTP 429/5xx responses, and wired basic circuit-breaker state to avoid thundering herds.
next_steps: Add /api/metrics endpoint to pages/api/metrics.ts returning JSON of session stats (activeSessions, queueDepth, cpuLoad, memGB, diskPercent, pausedCount).
Add retry logic with exponential backoff and jitter to lib/sse.ts sendStream() on network errors and HTTP 429/5xx with configurable maxAttempts.
Write unit tests for org_guard.py covering all forbidden path patterns and policy bypass edge cases.
Define per-session SLOs and backpressure rules in config/slos.ts (cpuThreshold=0.8, memThreshold=0.85, diskThreshold=0.8) and export enforceBackpressure().
Add backpressure integration to orchestrator.py throttleSession() using SLO thresholds from config/slos.ts and emit metrics via pages/api/metrics.ts.
decisions: Adopt exponential backoff with jitter (base 1s, cap 30s) for all external calls (LLM/SSE) to reduce 429 storms under load.
Expose realtime hive metrics via /api/metrics to drive autoscaling and UI dashboards; prioritize CPU/mem/disk and paused counts.
Enforce per-session SLOs with hard caps and graceful degradation (pause/requeue) when thresholds are breached.
